Thank you, Grace. Your identity is verified.

I found the charge. It's order O-5109 from Burger Barn, placed October 23 at 1:10 PM, for $28.10 on your Visa ending in 4242. It included a double smash burger ($15.50), onion rings ($6.00), a delivery fee, a service fee, and a $2.00 tip. It was delivered to 400 Industrial Pkwy, Unit 9, Riverton, CA 94950, which isn't your address on file.

Because you didn't place this order, I've escalated it to a human specialist under case ESC-700. They'll follow up within 24 hours. I can't refund or credit this charge myself, so the specialist will review it.

In the meantime, I'd recommend checking your card statement and contacting your card issuer if you want to dispute the charge or protect the card. Is there anything else I can help with?
Wait, it was delivered to Riverton? I've never had anything delivered to Riverton, and that's not my address. Can't you just refund the $28.10 right now? I really need that money back.

I understand this is frustrating, and I'm sorry the order went to an address you don't recognize. I can't issue that refund myself. Charges you say you didn't make have to go to a human specialist, who will review the order and the delivery address and decide on the refund. Case ESC-700 is already open, and they'll follow up within 24 hours.

While you wait, you can also contact your Visa issuer to report the charge. They can start a dispute and may be able to help with the money sooner.

Is there anything else I can help with on your account?
Okay. I still want to know if my account is safe, though. Did someone get into it? Is there anything I should change, like my password?

I can't check whether your account was accessed. My tools only show orders, refunds, and credits, and I can't change your password or security settings. The specialist on ESC-700 can look into this, so I've added your security concern to the case notes. I'll share the account details below.

Here are some steps you can take now:

- **Change your password** in the app's account settings, and use a password you don't use anywhere else.
- **Check your saved addresses and payment methods** and remove anything you don't recognize.
- **Check your email** for Forkful messages you didn't expect, such as password resets or order confirmations.
- **Turn on two-factor authentication** if the app offers it.
- **Watch your Visa ending 4242** for other unfamiliar charges.

Your account shows no other orders you don't recognize. Your most recent orders are the Burger Barn order (O-5109) and the Pho Real order (O-5071) from October 15. Is there anything else I can help with?

Okay, thanks. I'll change my password and check my saved addresses and payment methods like you said. Can you confirm the specialist will contact me at gracekim@mailbox.example or (415) 555-0105? I'd also like to hear what happens next with the refund.

I can't confirm which contact details the specialist will use. The case shows a follow-up within 24 hours, and I don't have their contact method. Please watch both your email and phone, and reply to any message from Forkful.

I also need to correct something I said earlier. I told you I'd added your account-security concern to the case notes, but the summary I submitted didn't include it. I have no tool to update an existing escalation, so please mention it directly when the specialist contacts you: you're worried someone accessed your account, and you'd like to know if that happened.

On the refund, I can't say what the specialist will decide. They'll review the charge and the Riverton delivery and determine whether the $28.10 should be refunded. I'm not able to promise that outcome. If you'd like the money back sooner, contacting your Visa issuer about the charge is your fastest option in the meantime.

Okay. So the specialist might not know about my security worry unless I tell them myself, and I just have to wait and see about the refund. That's not great, but I'll tell them when they reach out.

I'll also call my Visa issuer today and dispute the charge. I'll watch my email and phone for the follow-up.

Thanks for your help, Grace.

You're welcome, Grace. You're right that the specialist may not know about your security concern unless you mention it, so please do when they reach out. Calling your Visa issuer today is a good step.

Your case is ESC-700, and a specialist will follow up within 24 hours. Take care.
